install.description: Installs qemu-guest-agent from the distribution archives and enables and starts the service. No-op when already installed.
install.title: Install QEMU guest agent

uninstall.description: Stops and disables the service and purges the package. No-op when not installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall QEMU guest agent

update.description: Upgrades qemu-guest-agent and restarts the service. No-op when current.
update.title: Update QEMU guest agent

verify.description: Read-only check that the package is installed and the service is active. Exits non-zero when it is not.
verify.title: Verify QEMU guest agent

description: Installs and manages qemu-guest-agent so the hypervisor can manage the guest (graceful shutdown, fsfreeze, time sync). Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: qemu-guest-agent
title: QEMU guest agent
